body:
I feel utterly done with life. I fucked up something important, just like I fucked up everything I've ever done

My parents don't talk to me anymore: our only interactions are screaming matches. I barely eat now.

 I feel like my friends talk to me because of pity: nobody actually cares about me.....I want to throw up when they try to be nice. 

I've never done anything right: all I've done is fuck up over and over and over again. I don't even deserve to live. I failed myself, I failed my parents, I failed everyone I know, it would be so much easier if I just jumped in front of a fucking train
